ns2:section.sectionText: This is a practical course on field research, whose primary purpose is to provide firsthand experience in conducting all aspects of a science project outside of controlled laboratory settings. The course will focus on birds, with the secondary purpose of exposing students to a variety of common field techniques and giving in depth training in banding and radio telemetry. These are marketable job skills that are often required or preferred in today's wildlife job market. This class will meet at the Anita Purves Nature Center, (1505 N. Broadway in Urbana). To request being added to the waiting list for this course, complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
